name: Varwof Scheme Administration (v1)
description: Provisional project-local scheme that states who may create, update, revoke, delegate and root-rotate a capability scheme package. This identifier is a project-local reference name, not a registered IETF or CLC namespace. The scheme defines management authority only; it adds no CLC grammar and no CLC verdict. A deployer recomputes authority from the publisher's AIC grant, the scheme package, the scheme transition and its own trust policy. See docs/scheme-admin-v1.md.
author: varwof
note: scheme:verify is deliberately absent. Schema, digest and compatibility verification is unprivileged and MAY be performed by any party. A signed verification result is governance evidence only when an explicit approval profile says so.

capabilities.description: Create the first package in an authorized namespace
capabilities.summary: Create generation 1 of a scheme package under a namespace the publisher administers
capabilities.usage: Used once per namespace, when the first immutable scheme package is proposed to a deployer.
capabilities.when_not: Not used to replace or amend an existing package; use scheme:update. Not used to re-create a revoked namespace without a new tombstone-aware decision.
examples: Bootstrap a new vendor scheme namespace

namespace.description: Absolute path-prefix namespace the package belongs to, e.g. /std/payments-v1

change_class.description: Single change class of this transition

major.description: Numeric major version of the package revision

capabilities.description: Transition from one package digest/generation to another
capabilities.summary: Replace the active package of a namespace with a strictly newer generation
capabilities.usage: Used for every patch, minor or major change after generation 1.
capabilities.when_not: Not used to move to the same generation, to roll back, or to resurrect a revoked digest.
examples: Apply a major version bump under an explicit major grant

namespace.description: Absolute path-prefix namespace the package belongs to

change_class.description: Single change class of this transition

major.description: Numeric major version of the target package revision

clc_revision.description: CLC revision the target package requires

capabilities.description: Revoke a package digest and create a tombstone
capabilities.summary: Publish a signed tombstone for an existing package digest
capabilities.usage: Used when a package must no longer be adopted. The tombstone names the revoked digest, the revocation generation, an effective time, a stable reason code and a replacement digest when known.
capabilities.when_not: Never used to physically delete an artifact. Public artifacts may already exist in caches, mirrors and audit logs.
examples: Revoke a package after a specification defect

namespace.description: Absolute path-prefix namespace the revoked package belongs to

package_digest.description: Digest of the package being revoked

capabilities.description: Delegate a strict subset of namespace/actions/versions
capabilities.summary: Issue a strictly narrower administration grant to another principal
capabilities.usage: Used to hand a sub-namespace, a subset of change classes, a lower major bound or a subset of CLC revisions to another administrator.
capabilities.when_not: Not used to widen a namespace, add a change class, raise a major bound or add a CLC revision. A delegation that is not strictly narrower is refused.

namespace.description: Absolute path-prefix namespace of the delegated authority

change_class.description: Change classes the delegate may use

major.description: Highest major version the delegate may publish

clc_revision.description: CLC revisions the delegate may publish under

capabilities.description: Replace the bootstrap administration root by threshold
capabilities.summary: Move the configured trust root from the current root keys to the next root keys
capabilities.usage: Used when the bootstrap root must change. The transition is authorized by the current root and satisfies the separately configured next-root threshold.
capabilities.when_not: Never accepted when the proposed next root authorizes its own installation, when the current root does not authorize it, or when the next-root threshold is not met.
examples: Rotate the bootstrap root key after a compromise
Hand administration to a new threshold key set

package_digest.description: Digest of the root administration package being replaced

capabilities.summary: Record an exact approval for one package and one transition digest
capabilities.usage: Used only when the deployer's trust policy requires an approval threshold. The approval pins the exact package digest and transition digest, so it cannot be replayed for another package.
capabilities.when_not: Not used as a substitute for scheme:create/update/revoke authority, and not used when the deployer requires no approval.
examples: Second approver signs a specific transition
Release board approval for a major version

namespace.description: Absolute path-prefix namespace of the approved package

package_digest.description: Exact digest of the approved package

transition_digest.description: Exact digest of the approved transition
